name: OSS_BALANCE_BILL_LINES
description: Following table is used to capture balance billing information

columns.name: BALANCE_BILL_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for balance bill lines.

columns.name: BALANCE_BILL_LINE_PUID
columns.description: Alternate identifier for balance bill lines.

columns.name: ROOT_BILL_LINE_ID
columns.description: This field stores the unique identifier of the root bill line linked to the balance bill line.

columns.name: PARENT_BILL_LINE_ID
columns.description: This field records the unique identifier of the parent bill line that is linked to the balance bill line.

columns.name: BILL_LINE_ID
columns.description: This field records the unique identifier of the bill line that is linked to the balance bill line.

columns.name: BILL_SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: This field stores the bill sequence number that uniquely identifies the billing instance linked to the specific balance bill line.

columns.name: USAGE_QUANTITY
columns.description: This field stores the usage quantity linked to the specific balance bill line.

columns.description: This field stores the usage quantity linked to the specific balance bill line.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
